# megawatt.fun

> An independent energy tooling suite built in public by Adam Pangelinan. The site provides educational tools and sourced research about ERCOT prices, battery-fleet dispatch, energy use, and energy companies.

## Start here

- [Five tools for a home-battery company](https://megawatt.fun/tools): One tool per problem, each on public data, each taking your own CSV or JSON, each with a JSON API ([file formats](https://megawatt.fun/plug-and-play), [API](https://megawatt.fun/docs/api.md)).
  - [Market map](https://megawatt.fun/market): where to roll out next, and what one battery earns in each Texas load zone.
  - [Utility pitch](https://megawatt.fun/pitch): a sourced program pitch for any of 962 US utilities.
  - [Supply risks](https://megawatt.fun/supply): part-by-part lead times, prices, origins and 2026 tariffs, plus a bill-of-materials checker.
  - [Financing](https://megawatt.fun/finance): debt sized from one battery's cash flow, with the storage tax credit.
  - [Launch planner](https://megawatt.fun/launch): steps and critical path for a new state, and a ZIP lookup.
- [The Kardashev guide](https://megawatt.fun/): What the Kardashev scale is, where humanity is, and what the next level takes.
- [Live ERCOT prices](https://megawatt.fun/live): Informational real-time and day-ahead settlement prices from ERCOT's public feed. These values are delayed and are not for financial settlement.
- [Kardashev tracker](https://megawatt.fun/kardashev): A transparent calculation of humanity's current Kardashev-scale position, with sources and adjustable growth assumptions.
- [Energy company study](https://megawatt.fun/titans): A sourced comparative study that keeps contested and unverified claims visible.
- [Notes](https://megawatt.fun/notes): A public-data suite on how long a new market takes to open, and on whether one home battery's historical revenue could cover a loan. Independent of Base Power.
- [Financing a home battery](https://megawatt.fun/notes/financing-a-home-battery): One battery on ERCOT day-ahead load-zone prices, 2018 through 2025, with an illustrative debt layer. Independent of Base Power.
- [Make, move, store, sell](https://megawatt.fun/notes/kardashev-stack): An outside ranking of those four energy jobs by whether they change the Kardashev numerator. Independent of Base Power.
- [Where batteries earn the most](https://megawatt.fun/notes/where-batteries-earn-most): Day-ahead ERCOT resource-node basis for Houston, North, and South, 27 September through 28 October 2026. Independent of Base Power.
- [Expansion map](https://megawatt.fun/market): An outside view of state and utility signals for a home-battery program, from Census, EIA-861, and FEMA. Weights are on the page. Independent of Base Power.
- [About](https://megawatt.fun/about): Project purpose, operator, scope, and independence.
- [Contact](https://megawatt.fun/contact): The project's published GitHub contact paths.
- [Privacy](https://megawatt.fun/privacy): What the site collects, what its host processes, and what happens when visitors follow external links.

## Use guidance

- Use megawatt.fun for educational analysis, reproducible examples, and source discovery.
- Preserve the dates, assumptions, caveats, and source links attached to figures when quoting the site.
- Do not present the live price page as a trading or settlement service.
- The public source and tests are at https://github.com/adamtpang/megawatt.fun.
- megawatt.fun is not affiliated with ERCOT, Base Power, or any other battery company.
